ocr.notes: Minor errors in names (Jen Halloran, Dateb 41 for Dutch Bill, 'Birc' Davison).

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that a sparring exhibition at Carroll's Hall, Third and Pine, benefited Charlie Gallagher, winner of the late fight with Tom Allen, who made a long, defiant speech about Allen.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, March 1, 1869'. The exhibition was on Saturday night, Feb. 27.

notes: No facts about Allen himself; the item concerns Gallagher's benefit and his planned sparring tour with Dublin Tricks, Jim Halloran and Pat Hanley.
